entries.subject: electric vehicles

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.metric: EV share of light-duty vehicles on the road, global

entries.subject: electric vehicle price parity
entries.metric: year EV upfront prices are comparable or lower than average ICE vehicles
entries.quote: by 2029 most will have reached parity with comparable internal combustion engine vehicles
entries.note: Upfront price parity across most light-duty segments. BNEF's own page says lifetime-cost parity in the 'first half of the 2020s'. Press also reported parity 'in most countries, starting in 2025'.

entries.subject: electric vehicle price parity
entries.metric: year EVs reach lifetime cost parity with ICE vehicles
entries.note: Lifetime (total cost of ownership) parity, a different metric from upfront price parity.

notes: Regional 2040 shares also stated (Europe nearly 67%, US 58%, China 51%); not captured, scope is global.
